proposals.evidence: Full cammakka section 2 gives Bengali camak flash, regional camaknā/camkanu/camakṇā to shine, and Punjabi camkār/camkārā flash. These support simple camak/cemek, verbal camkni/cemekna/cemkev and camkṛi-type lightning responses. Preserve source vowels and ordinary endings with local formation and cross-IA transmission qualified. Use section 2, not the separate startle branch 1. Exact response: camak.
